text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...!
Is my belt tighter than usual...?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kh, why...
Come to think of it, lately—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Mmh... delicious! This hamburg steak is bursting with juice, it's so juicy.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This sauce is so rich, too...
It really makes you want to scarf down more rice!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad it suits your taste!
You take care of me so much, Senpai...
There are plenty of seconds, too!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Lately, my juniors kept treating me to meals
to thank me for usual things...
I didn't want to turn down their kindness, so I ended up eating too much.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Neglecting weight management is a disgrace to my knightly name...
I must take countermeasures immediately.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"'Lose weight healthily! The Jump Rope Diet.'
Huh... Shaping up without losing muscle mass sounds pretty nice."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let's multiply the jumps by five!
That way, the effect will be five times greater!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's a bit tough, but...
that's proof we're getting five times the results!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Just as I thought, it's just right.
Starting tomorrow, we're sticking with 5x effectiveness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to continuing jump rope with five times the normal resistance,
Durandal was able to get her weight back to normal.
